sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31516 of 2022
Applicant :- Sahil

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Sharma

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 122 of 2022,
under Section 363,366,376 I.P.C. and 3/4 Protection of Children from Sexual Offence (POCSO) Act,
2012, Police Station Delhigate, District Aligarh with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text:
Protection of Children from Sexual Offence (POCSO) Act,
2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is argued by the argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Charge sheet has been submitted in this case.
There is no eye witness of the incident.
Victim accompanied with the applicant at her own accord.
It is submitted that applicant has criminal history of one case, which has been explained in supplementary affidavit as Annexure-SA-1.
The age of victim is 16 years.
Victim in her statements under section 161/164 Cr. P.C. has not corroborated the commission of rape with her by the applicant.

It has been further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 05.05.2022 having no criminal history and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. assisted by learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the age of victim is 16 years and she is minor.
Being minor, her consent is immaterial as recorded in her statement under section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
Applicant has abducted the victim forcibly and committed rape.
It is further submitted that the victim has been recovered along with the present applicant.
Applicant is not entitled for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of allegations, gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that no case for grant of bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby rejected.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.
